findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "directory" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: price_item, list_on_ebay · Private data: price_item · Public sink: list_on_ebay · Destructive: get_sold_comps.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: price_item, list_on_ebay · Private data: price_item · Public sink: list_on_ebay · Destructive: get_sold_comps

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
